reason: The cited evidence supports that reducing Ta decreases strength and reducing Hf increases strength, but it does not address Al substitution, its effect on density, or the retention of a single-phase BCC structure and high-temperature strength, leaving several key premises unsupported.
premises: Reducing Hf and Ta content lowers density
Reducing Ta content decreases yield strength
Reducing Hf content increases yield strength
A 10 at.% substitution of Hf and Ta with Al retains a single-phase BCC structure
The substitution preserves high-temperature strength with only a minor compromise
